strings.subscription_cancel_body: Are you sure you want to cancel your subscription? You will continue to have access until the end of your current billing period. After that, your account will revert to the Free tier.
strings.subscription_cancelled_notice: Your subscription has been cancelled. Access continues until the end of the billing period.
strings.subscription_cancel_card_body: If you cancel, your premium features will remain available until the end of your current billing period.
strings.subscription_restore_body: If you have previously purchased a subscription on another device, tap below to restore it.
strings.subscription_plans_unavailable: Premium plan purchases are not available in this app. If your Chess99 account has a premium plan, it is active here automatically.

edits:
Text(
                        "Are you sure you want to cancel your subscription? " +
                            "You will continue to have access until the end of your " +
                            "current billing period. After that, your account will " +
                            "revert to the Free tier.",
                    )

val statusText = when {
                subscription?.isActive == true -> "Active"
                subscription?.isCancelled == true -> "Cancelled"
                subscription?.isExpired == true -> "Expired"
                tier == "free" -> "Free Tier"
                else -> "No Subscription"
            }

label = stringResource(
                        if (subscription.isCancelled) R.string.subscription_access_until
                        else R.string.subscription_renews_on
                    ),

label = stringResource(R.string.subscription_auto_renew),
                value = stringResource(
                    if (subscription.autoRenew) R.string.subscription_enabled
                    else R.string.subscription_disabled
                ),
"Your subscription has been cancelled. Access continues until the end of the billing period.",

"If you cancel, your premium features will remain available until " +
                    "the end of your current billing period.",

"If you have previously purchased a subscription on another device, " +
                    "tap below to restore it.",

text = "Premium plan purchases are not available in this app. " +
                    "If your Chess99 account has a premium plan, it is active " +
                    "here automatically.",
